For example, in the images of Lori Loud from The Loud House on Google, there used to be an image where Lori stands in front of a fridge shrugging which is from an episode of which I forgot the name, and one where she sits at a table with a pencil in her mouth. There were also some images from the episode of Adventure Time "Something Big", such as one where Princess Bubblegum stands somewhere in the part when she wondered where is Finn, one where she stood and said "Alright" before she went on the flying swan, and one where she is on the swan before it flies away, in which she also has a green outline.

reviews.verbatim_quote_summary: Recent updates have introduced a bunch of bugs that make it really inconvenient to use daily. The grid view has random large or elongated photos making it hard to scan photos and f
reviews.text: Recent updates have introduced a bunch of bugs that make it really inconvenient to use daily. The grid view has random large or elongated photos making it hard to scan photos and follow their chronological order. The edit tools randomly switch order, making it take longer to find specific tools. Select and drag is completely bugged, making it tedious to select more than one photo. Really disappointing, as this was one of the most polished Google apps but is now buggy and a chore to use.

reviews.verbatim_quote_summary: What a terribly oversimplified Android app, you can't select photos from anywhere but your camera roll. If I use a file application, there's "upload to photos" after tapping the sh
reviews.text: What a terribly oversimplified Android app, you can't select photos from anywhere but your camera roll. If I use a file application, there's "upload to photos" after tapping the share icon, but that disappears as an option when you select more than one photo. I could upload them to Drive however, so I did that only to find out on the Android photos app you can't add photos from your Google Drive. It's too Appley "stay in this single lane" of an experience.

reviews.verbatim_quote_summary: I've loved Google Photos for the longest time, I've even upgraded my Google One so my family can have more storage, since we are both starting our own businesses we are required to
reviews.text: I've loved Google Photos for the longest time, I've even upgraded my Google One so my family can have more storage, since we are both starting our own businesses we are required to take a lot of photos and screenshots for our work. There was recently an update that drastically slowed how quickly our photos load even on device photos. I fully expect when you have a flagship phone and a premium membership for your photos to load much quicker.

reviews.verbatim_quote_summary: I've been using this app for years, and overall haven't had any problems. 1 thing I've recently been having to deal with is running out of free storage space (for backed up photos)
reviews.text: I've been using this app for years, and overall haven't had any problems. 1 thing I've recently been having to deal with is running out of free storage space (for backed up photos). I very much wish I could manually select and choose which photos are backed up vs not. Stuff from Pinterest, screenshots, etc, I wish I could select these photos to not be backed up, and only back up important photos from my camera roll or photos sent from friends. I would be so grateful if this became an app feature

reviews.verbatim_quote_summary: automatic backup is nice, although it is very annoying that there is no easy way to un-backup an image once uploaded. Random large images on the photos view is a terrible eyesore,
reviews.text: automatic backup is nice, although it is very annoying that there is no easy way to un-backup an image once uploaded. Random large images on the photos view is a terrible eyesore, it was fine before there was no need to make it worse. Collections tab is annoying: albums are too large and there is no way to choose which image is displayed for them, there is no way to order them, there is no way to remove the useless documents tab which nobody would ever use. Hiding places tab would be good too.
